title: Election Integrity Partnership
summary: 2020 coalition linking Stanford Internet Observatory, University of Washington CIP, Graphika, and Atlantic Council DFRLab to election officials, government agencies, platforms, media, and researchers through a ticket-based misinformation response process.

sources.title: The Long Fuse: Misinformation and the 2020 Election

data.name: Election Integrity Partnership
members: University of Washington Center for an Informed Public
Atlantic Council Digital Forensic Research Lab
process: identify actors, pathways, narratives, and infrastructure
share findings and counter-messaging across stakeholders
data.platform_policy_role: The final report says the partnership helped strengthen platform standards, documented platform suspensions, removals, downranking, sharing restrictions, and labels, and recommended probation, monitoring, and sanctions for repeat policy violators.
data.authority_limit: No source reviewed establishes that the EIP or Graphika possessed direct authority to execute platform moderation.
